sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash - unsloth.ai
sources.snippet: Thank you Z.ai for day zero access. GLM-5.3-Flash is built on a newly trained base model redesigned for greater capability and efficiency. Its hybrid sparse and linear attention architecture lowers long-context serving costs without sacrificing accuracy, while Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections improve scaling.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 - openlm.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3 is our latest flagship model for coding and long-horizon tasks. It marks a substantial leap in long-horizon task capability over its predecessor GLM-5.1 and delivers that capability on a solid 1M-token context. It is pure open with an MIT open-source license — no regional limits, technical access without borders.

sources.title: zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash | vLLM Recipes - recipes.vllm.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash is a 320B-total / 18B-active multimodal MoE with hybrid KDA and sparse MLA attention, native FP8 weights, MTP, and a 1M-token context window.
